examples.text: pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhīl'ūpamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.

64201.meaning1: virtuous person; one of good conduct; religious person

examples.text: udakañ'hi nayanti nettikā, usukārā namayanti tejanaṃ, dāruṃ namayanti tacchakā, attānaṃ damayanti subbatā.

64202.meaning1: easily instructed; easily guided; easily converted

examples.text: nivissavādī na hi subbināyo, pakappitaṃ diṭṭhi purekkharāno, yaṃ nissito tattha subhaṃ vadāno, suddhiṃvado tattha tath'addasā so.

64203.notes: The spelling with -bb- is influenced by dubbuṭṭhi, suvuṭṭhi is more correct.

examples.text: atha naṃ sesajanā, amma, tayā katasassaṃ n'eva accodakena, na anudakena nassati, subbuṭṭhidubbuṭṭhibhāvaṃ ñatvā kammaṃ karosi, kiṃ nu kho etan'ti pucchiṃsu.

64204.grammar: masc, atta group, irreg, from brahma

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho subrahmā devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi

64205.grammar: masc, atta group, irreg, from brahma

examples.text: subrahmā paramatto ca, puttā iddhimato saha, sanaṅkumāro tisso ca, s'opāga samitiṃ vanaṃ.
seyyathā'pi nāma maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
anattani, bhikkhave, attā'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso. asubhe, bhikkhave, subhan'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.
nivissavādī na hi subbināyo, pakappitaṃ diṭṭhi purekkharāno, yaṃ nissito subhaṃ vadāno, suddhiṃvado tattha tath'addasā so.

64209.commentary: (MNa) subho'ti so kira dassanīyo ahosi pāsādiko, ten'assa aṅgasubhatāya subhotv'eva nāmaṃ akaṃsu.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena subho māṇavo todeyyaputto sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati aññatarassa gahapatissa nivesane kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

64210.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: sumbho subho matulo aṭṭhamo ca, ath'assumegho anīgho sudāṭho, paccekabuddhā bhavanettikhīṇā, hiṅgū ca hiṅgo ca mah'ānubhāvā.

64212.meaning1: name of a heavenly realm; name of a class of deities
64212.commentary: (VIBHa) subhena okiṇṇā vikiṇṇā, subhena sarīrappabhāvaṇṇena ekagghanā, suvaṇṇamañjusāya ṭhapita-sampajjalita-kañcana-piṇḍa-sassirīkā'ti subhakiṇhā.

examples.text: atthi kho, brahme, subhakiṇho nāma kāyo, vehapphalo nāma kāyo, abhibhū nāma kāyo, taṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi na passasi, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi passāmi.

subhakiṇhe subhakiṇhato sañjānāti, subhakiṇhe subhakiṇhato saññatvā subhakiṇhe maññati, subhakiṇhesu maññati, subhakiṇhato maññati, subhakiṇhe me'ti maññati, subhakiṇhe abhinandati. taṃ kissa hetu? apariññātaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.

64213.meaning1: epithet of a class of devas
64213.commentary: (VIBHa) subhena okiṇṇā vikiṇṇā, subhena sarīrappabhāvaṇṇena ekagghanā, suvaṇṇamañjusāya ṭhapita-sampajjalita-kañcana-piṇḍa-sassirīkā'ti subhakiṇhā.

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā subhakiṇhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā subhakiṇhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
so abyābajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno abyābajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti ek'antasukhaṃ, seyyathā'pi devā subhakiṇhā.

64214.meaning1: fact of being a subhakiṇha deity

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ, taṃ… ābhassarānaṃ ābhassarattena ananubhūtaṃ, subhakiṇhānaṃ subhakiṇhattena ananubhūtaṃ, vehapphalānaṃ vehapphalatte ananubhūtaṃ, abhibhussa abhibhuttena ananubhūtaṃ, sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ.

64215.commentary: (MNa) subhagavane'ti ettha subhagattā subhagaṃ, sundarasirikattā sundarakāmattā cā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (SNa) tādisā subhagiyā'ti tādisāya subhariyāya.

examples.text: ekam'id'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, samayaṃ ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi subhagavane sālarājamūle.
tassā yo jāyati poso, sūro hoti disampati, tādisā subhagiyā putto, rajjam'pi anusāsatī'ti.

64216.meaning1: creating good luck; good luck charm

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṃkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ

64217.meaning1: name of a wood in Ukkaṭṭhā

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharati subhagavane sālarājamūle. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavo'ti. bhadante'ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.

64218.meaning1: from Subhaga forest; living in Subhaga wood

examples.text: samaṇo gotamo pāpito bhavissatī'ti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, brāhmaṇo, bho gotama, pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko evam'āha, evam'eva pan'idh'ekacce samaṇabrāhmaṇā uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ paṭijānanti.
subhaṭo nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

64221.meaning1: continuously attractive; remaining beautiful; in a state of glory

examples.text: te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhecarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
gihino'pi ijjhati yathā bhaṇato, atha ce pabbajati so manujo, ādiyantissa vacanaṃ janatā, bahuno bahuṃ subhaṇitaṃ bhaṇato'ti.
bahukā tava dinnābharaṇā, ucc'āvacā subhaṇitamhi, muttāmaṇiveḷuriyā, etaṃ te pacchimakaṃ dānaṃ.

64223.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; last person to get ordained under the Buddha
64223.meaning2: personal name of an arahant monk; last person to get ordained under the Buddha

examples.text: aññataro kho pan'āyasmā subhaddo arahataṃ ahosi. so bhagavato pacchimo sakkhisāvako ahosī'ti.

64224.meaning1: name of a monk who rejoiced news of the Buddha's death
64224.meaning2: name of a monk who rejoiced news of the Buddha's death
64224.commentary: (DNa) subhaddo nāma vuḍḍhapabbajito'ti subhaddo'ti tassa nāmaṃ. vuḍḍhakāle pana pabbajitattā vuḍḍhapabbajito'ti vuccati. kasmā pana so evam'āha? bhagavati āghātena.

examples.text: atha kho subhaddo vuddhapabbajito te bhikkhū etadavoca, alaṃ, āvuso, mā socittha, mā paridevittha, sumuttā mayaṃ tena mahāsamaṇena. upaddutā ca homa, idaṃ vo kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatī'ti.
subhaddo nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

64226.meaning2: truly fine; of very good quality; just excellent; highly valuable

examples.text: bhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me na'y'ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī'ti.

64227.meaning1: story of Subhadda the wandering ascetic
64227.meaning2: the story of Subhadda the wandering ascetic

64228.meaning1: name of a queen; wife of king Mahāsudassana

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītiitthisahassāni ahesuṃ subhaddādevippamukhāni.

64231.meaning1: with queen Subhaddā as the foremost (among them)

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītiitthisahassāni ahesuṃ subhaddādevippamukhāni.

64232.meaning1: state of beauty; element of attractiveness

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, bhante, ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākās'ānañc'āyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu yā ca nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu, imā nu kho, bhante, dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantī'ti?

64233.commentary: (SNa) subhanimittan'ti subham'pi subhanimittaṃ, subhassa ārammaṇam'pi subhanimittaṃ. (ANa) subhanimitte'ti rāgaṭṭhāniye iṭṭh'ārammaṇe

examples.text: subhanimittaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasi karoto anuppanno c'eva kāmacchando uppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī'ti
ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, subhanimittaṃ.

64234.meaning1: pursuit of attractive objects; devotion to beauty

examples.text: dasa'y'ime, bhikkhave, kaṇṭakā. katame dasa? pavivek'ārāmassa saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā kaṇṭako, asubhanimitt'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa subhanimitt'ānuyogo kaṇṭako

64235.meaning1: but only on the beautiful; but only on the attractive

examples.text: rūpī rūpāni passati, ayaṃ ekā disā, ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati, ayaṃ dutiyā disā, subhan'tv'eva adhimutto hoti, ayaṃ tatiyā disā

64236.meaning1: having the beautiful as peak; with beauty as apex

examples.text: subhaparam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, mettācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idhapaññassa bhikkhuno uttarivimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.

64237.meaning1: story of the young Brahman Subha

64238.construction:
su + bhaya + āna + ka
subhayāna + ka

examples.text: addasā kho aññataro bhikkhu paṭibhānakūṭe mahantaṃ papātaṃ. disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, mahā vat'āyaṃ, bhante, papāto subhayānako, bhante, papāto.
santussako ca subharo ca, appakicco ca sallahukavutti, sant'indriyo ca nipako ca, appagabbho kulesu ananugiddho.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'aṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu, app'āhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto

64240.meaning1: fact of being easy to support; fact of being low maintenance

examples.text: tañ'hi tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno dīgharattaṃ app'icchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya subharatāya vīriy'ārambhāya saṃvattissati
vīriy'ārambhāya saṃvattanti, no kosajjāya, subharatāya saṃvattanti, no dubbharatāyā

64241.meaning1: easy to support; easy to maintain

examples.text: tassā yo jāyati poso, sūro hoti disampati, tādisā subhariyāputto, rajjam'pi anusāsatī'ti.
anicce niccasaññino, dukkhe ca sukhasaññino, anattani ca attā'ti, asubhe subhasaññino, micchādiṭṭhihatā sattā, khittacittā visaññino.
jīvak'ambavanaṃ rammaṃ, gacchantiṃ bhikkhuniṃ subhaṃ, dhuttako sannivāresi, tam'enaṃ abravī subhā.
subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.
vitakkamathitassa jantuno, tibbarāgassa subh'ānupassino, bhiyyo taṇhā pavaḍḍhati, esa kho daḷhaṃ karoti bandhanaṃ.
yathā'pi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ, vaṇṇavantaṃ agandhakaṃ, evaṃ subhāsitā vācā, aphalā hoti akubbato.
atha kho aparā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kassa nu kho, bhagavā, subhāsitan'ti? sabbāsaṃ vo subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena, api ca mama'pi suṇātha

64252.meaning1: good speech; eloquent communication; well-spoken words

examples.text: sutvāna corā isino subhāsitaṃ, nikkhippa satthāni ca āvudhāni ca, tamhā ca kammā viramiṃsu eke, eke ca pabbajjam'arocayiṃsu.
anusūyāyamāno so, samma'd'aññāya bhāsati, subhāsitaṃ anumodeyya, dubbhaṭṭhe n'āpasādaye.

64254.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of subhāsita
64254.meaning1: as good speech; as eloquent words

examples.text: bhūtaṃ kho pana tacchaṃ tathaṃ paṭipadaṃ paññapentassa dhammaṭṭhitataṃ dhammaniyāmataṃ, kathañ'hi nāma mādiso viññū samaṇassa gotamassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato n'ābbhanumodeyyā'ti?

64255.meaning1: good and bad speech; well or badly spoken words

examples.text: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī, na petī, na tiracchānagatā. viññū paṭibalā subhāsitadubbhāsitaṃ duṭṭhull'āduṭṭhullaṃ ājānituṃ.

64256.meaning1: to know the meaning of what is well spoken and what is badly spoken

examples.text: so ca hoti duppañño jaḷo eḷamūgo, nappaṭibalo subhāsita-dubbhāsitānam'attham'aññātuṃ. ayaṃ aṭṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
bhāsaye jotaye dhammaṃ, paggaṇhe isinaṃ dhajaṃ, subhāsitadhajā isayo, dhammo hi isinaṃ dhajo'ti.
no c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca abhavissa subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca, kena naṃ paṇḍitā jāneyyuṃ, paṇḍito ayaṃ bhavaṃ sappuriso'ti?

64261.meaning1: beautiful and ugly; attractive and repulsive

examples.text: yo'dha dīghaṃ va rassaṃ vā, aṇuṃ thūlaṃ subh'āsubhaṃ, loke adinnaṃ n'ādiyati, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
yathā agāraṃ suchannaṃ, vuṭṭhī na samativijjhati, evaṃ subhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo na samativijjhati.
ekadhamme patiṭṭhitassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pañc'indriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni. katamasmiṃ ekadhamme? appamāde.
yena yena subhikkhāni, sivāni abhayāni ca, tena puttaka gacchassu, mā sokāpahato bhavā'ti.
gacchatha, tātā, pabbatapādaṃ pavisitvā jīvantā subhikkhakāle mama santikaṃ āgantu'kāmā āgacchatha, anāgantu'kāmā tattha tatth'eva jīvathā'ti.

64264.meaning1: abundance of food; prosperity; enough food to eat

examples.text: so taṃ purisaṃ tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañ'ca subhikkhatañ'ca app'ābādhatañ'ca puccheyya, tassa so puriso tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañ'ca subhikkhatañ'ca app'ābādhatañ'ca saṃseyya.

64265.meaning1: with beautiful arms; having strong arms

examples.text: subhujo susu susaṇṭhito sujāto, mudutalun'aṅguliy'assa honti, dīghā tībhi purisavar'aggalakkhaṇehi, cirayapanāya kumāram'ādisanti.

64267.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in living without conflict; foremost monk worthy of gifts
64267.commentary: (THa) subhūtī'ti nāmakittanaṃ. so hi sarīrasampattiyā'pi dassanīyo pāsādiko, guṇasampattiyā'pi. iti sundarāya sarīr'āvayavavibhūtiyā sīlasampattiy'ādivibhūtiyā ca samannāgatattā subhūtī'ti paññāyittha
64267.notes: Theragāthā verse 1 (TH1.1, TH1) is attributed to him.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā subhūti saddhena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ araṇavihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ subhūti.

64269.commentary: (PMa) subhūtitthero pana ayaṃ micchāpaṭipadā, ayaṃ sammāpaṭipadā'ti dhammavasen'eva dhammaṃ desesi. ten'eva bhagavā taṃ'y'eva araṇapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti ca vaṇṇesi, etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ araṇavihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ subhūtī'ti (a. ni. 1.198, 201) ca araṇavihārīnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapesī'ti.
64269.notes: Theragāthā verse 1 (TH1.1, TH1) is attributed to him.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā subhūtitthero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

64273.meaning1: with good earth; having fertile soil

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya. so tattha sukhette subhūme suvihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhapeyya akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avāt'ātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni. devo ca kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.

64274.commentary: (ANa) subhūmiyan'ti samabhūmiyaṃ. subhūme sukhette vihatakhāṇuke bījāni patiṭṭhāpeyyā'ti ettha pana maṇḍabhūmi subhūmī'ti āgatā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ catumahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo.
atha kho rājā korabyo migavaṃ āmantesi, sodhehi, samma migava, migacīraṃ uyyānabhūmiṃ, gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyā'ti.

64276.meaning1: seeing the sights; looking at the scenery
64276.meaning2: seeing the sights; looking at the scenery

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bahūnaṃ vassānaṃ bahūnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahūnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena sārathiṃ āmantesi, yojehi, samma sārathi, bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmidassanāyā'ti.

64278.commentary: (ANa) sv'eva divaso katamaṅgalo nāma hoti, ten'assa sadā sumaṅgalan'ti vuccati. pabhātam'pi'ssa sadā suppabhātam'eva, sayanato uṭṭhānam'pi suhuṭṭhitam'eva, khaṇo'pi sukkhaṇo'va, muhutto'pi sumuhutto'va.

examples.text: sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, suppabhātaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ, sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.

64279.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: ketumbharāgo ca mātaṅgo ariyo, ath'accuto accutagāmabyāmako, sumaṅgalo dabbilo supatiṭṭhito, asayho khem'ābhirato ca sorato.

64283.meaning1: commentary on the Dīgha Nikāya compiled by Buddhaghosa

examples.text: [appiyehi… vippayogopi dukkho'ti pāṭho c'eva taṃniddeso ca sī. pī. potthakesu na dissati, sumaṅgalavilāsiniyaṃ'pi taṃsaṃvaṇṇanā n'atthi]

64284.construction:
su + majjha + anha + ika
sumajjhanha + ika

examples.text: ye, bhikkhave, sattā majjh'anhikasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, sumajjh'anhiko, bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānaṃ.
paṭikacc'eva khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karitvā sumatikataṃ kālena bījāni patiṭṭhāpeti. kālena bījāni patiṭṭhāpetvā samayena udakaṃ abhineti'pi apaneti'pi.
tathā tu kassāmi yathā'pi issaro, yaṃ labbhati tena'pi hotu me alaṃ, na t'āhaṃ kassāmi yathā atandito, biḷārabhastaṃ'va yathā sumadditaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, biḷārabhastā madditā sumadditā suparimadditā, mudukā tūlinī chinnasassarā chinnabhabbharā. atha puriso āgaccheyya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kathalaṃ vā ādāya.

64288.synonym: attamana, avighātavant, āraddhacitta, tuṭṭhi, patīta, patītarūpa, pamodavant, pīṇa, mudita, sammudita, sukhita, susajjita, somanassajāta, somanassita
64288.commentary: (ANa) n'eva sumano hotī'ti iṭṭh'ārammaṇe rāgavasena na somanassajāto hoti.

examples.text: te pabbajitvā sugatassa sāsane, bhāvetva bojjh'aṅgabalāni paṇḍitā, udaggacittā sumanā kat'indriyā, phusiṃsu nibbānapadaṃ asaṅkhatan'ti.
tañ'ca kammaṃ kataṃ sādhu, yaṃ katvā n'ānutappati, yassa patīto sumano, vipākaṃ paṭisevati.

64295.meaning1: paid good attention to; well attended to; applied the mind well

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇānimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya.
atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhanumodi, sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu, suggahitāni te, bhikkhu, soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni sūpadhāritāni

64299.commentary: (ANa) sumanā rājakumārī'ti mahāsakkāraṃ katvā patthanaṃ patthetvā evaṃ laddhanāmā rājakaññā. vipassi-sammāsambuddha-kālasmiṃ hi nāgaresu yuddham'pi katvā satthāraṃ amhākaṃ gaṇhissāmā'ti senāpatiṃ nissāya buddhappamukhaṃ saṅghaṃ labhitvā paṭipāṭiyā puññāni kātuṃ āraddhesu sabbapaṭhamadivaso senāpatissa vāro ahosi. tasmiṃ divase senāpati mahādānaṃ sajjetvā ajja yathā añño koci ekabhikkham'pi na deti, evaṃ rakkhathā'ti samantā purise ṭhapesi. taṃdivasaṃ seṭṭhibhariyā rodamānā pañcahi kumārikāsatehi saddhiṃ kīḷitvā āgataṃ dhītaraṃ āha, sace, amma, tava pitā jīveyya, ajj'āhaṃ paṭhamaṃ dasabalaṃ bhojeyyan'ti. sā taṃ āha, amma, mā cintayi, ahaṃ tathā karissāmi, yathā buddhappamukho saṅgho amhākaṃ paṭhamaṃ bhikkhaṃ bhuñjissatī'ti. tato satasahassagghanikāya suvaṇṇapātiyā nirudakapāyāsaṃ pūretvā sappimadhusakkhar'ādīhi abhisaṅkharitvā aññissā pātiyā paṭikujjitvā taṃ sumanamālāguḷehi parikkhipitvā mālāguḷasadisaṃ katvā bhagavato gāmaṃ pavisanavelāya sayam'eva ukkhipitvā dhātigaṇaparivutā gharā nikkhami.

examples.text: atha kho sumanā rājakumārī pañcahi rathasatehi pañcahi rājakumārisatehi parivutā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho sumanā rājakumārī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
